public_rationale: Independent reporting confirms that Marcus publicly criticized GPT-2's limitations in October 2019. That supports his characterization as an early skeptic. It does not establish that he made the overselling argument from the outset of his LLM commentary, and the post leaves that outset undefined. No contradictory early position was established either.
limitations: The documented criticism concerns GPT-2 and cannot establish his entire earlier record.
This assessment does not judge whether his substantive criticism of LLMs was correct.
